Game Overview

At its heart, Steve vs Alex Rocketman is a adventure game about guide astronauts Steve and Alex through a perilous skyblock adventure. Strategically time movements to avoid sharp TNTs and deadly rocks, collect gold bars, and reach the safety of the portal. This game blends pixelated charm with intense strategic gameplay in a quest for survival amid immersive challenges.
